description: Offline snapshot verification (section 9): run verifySnapshot(token, expected) and compare outcome, either { "snapshot": … } with the parsed snapshot when it verifies, or the error raised, with its kind, its code for a SnapshotError and its exact message. expected.keys is the key set snapshotKeys() answers or its keys list, and an absent issuer means the default https://api.entitler.dev/customers. Messages change only as section 3.1 allows (Go and Rust casing and full stop, identifiers in the language's spelling). In a snapshot, entitlements.items hold each entitlement's key, type, value, entitled, upgrades and meter fields. upgrades is always empty, since claims carry no upgrades and offline gating never offers a purchase; an upgrades member inside a claim item is a member the claims schema does not name, so it is ignored. absent names the meter fields an item lacks and is left out when it lacks none, has maps keys to Entitlements.has(key), and get maps keys to Entitlements.get(key), the entitlement with its empty upgrades, or null for none. A case with appliesWhere runs only where that holds. Tokens carry random ECDSA signatures, so a rebuild changes them but no outcome.

cases.name: verified-with-key-set
cases.why: A valid snapshot verifies against the key set snapshotKeys() answers, and its entitlements keep entitled and the group items as the server decided them.

cases.name: verified-with-key-list
cases.why: The same token verifies when expected.keys is the keys list rather than the key set.

cases.name: verified-track-following-a-change
cases.why: A snapshot from a track that follows a change has release null and the change id; the second key signed it, and a metered feature with no allowance left stays not entitled although its value is 1000.

cases.name: verified-live-with-no-entitlements
cases.why: A snapshot with an empty entitlements list and testers false verifies, and has answers false for any key.

cases.name: verified-with-matching-custom-issuer
cases.why: A custom expected issuer replaces the default, and a token from that issuer verifies.

cases.name: verified-signature-with-high-s
cases.why: ECDSA accepts s and n - s alike, and Entitler's signer does not normalise s, so a signature whose s is above half the curve order verifies.

cases.name: verified-signature-with-low-s
cases.why: A signature whose s is at most half the curve order verifies too.

cases.name: verified-r-with-leading-zero-byte
cases.why: The r half keeps its fixed 32-byte width in r||s when its first byte is zero, which catches conversions to DER that strip or pad bytes wrongly.

cases.name: verified-s-with-leading-zero-byte
cases.why: The s half keeps its fixed 32-byte width in r||s when its first byte is zero.

cases.name: verified-header-with-unknown-members
cases.why: Header members other than typ, alg, kid and crit are ignored, so verification never takes a key from the token's own jku or x5u.

cases.name: verified-with-unknown-claims
cases.why: Claims the schema does not name are ignored, so a snapshot with extra jti and region claims verifies.

cases.name: verified-with-unknown-fields-inside-claims
cases.why: Unknown fields inside the environment and track claims and inside an entitlement item are ignored, as section 6.2 asks.

cases.name: verified-with-unknown-feature-type
cases.why: A feature type the SDK does not know is kept as its raw string, never refused, as section 6.2 asks.

cases.name: verified-with-held-meter
cases.why: A metered item keeps held, the amount on hold, beside used, remaining and resetsAt, since section 6.2 lists held among the meter fields.

cases.name: verified-claim-item-with-upgrades-ignored
cases.why: Claim items carry no upgrades, so an upgrades member inside one, empty or naming a plan, is a member the claims schema does not name: it is ignored, the snapshot verifies, and each item still shows empty upgrades.

cases.name: verified-iat-at-lower-bound
cases.why: An iat of 0001-01-01T00:00:00Z, the first second of the years 0001 to 9999, is in range, and asOf keeps it.

cases.name: verified-exp-at-upper-bound
cases.why: An exp of 9999-12-31T23:59:59Z, the last second of the years 0001 to 9999, is in range, and expiresAt keeps it.

cases.name: two-segments
cases.why: A token without its signature segment is not in the compact form.

outcome.message: That is not an entitlements snapshot. Pass the token snapshot() returned.

cases.name: four-segments
cases.why: A fourth segment after a valid signature is refused before any key is looked up.

outcome.message: That is not an entitlements snapshot. Pass the token snapshot() returned.

cases.name: trailing-dot
cases.why: A trailing dot after a valid token makes a fourth, empty segment.

outcome.message: That is not an entitlements snapshot. Pass the token snapshot() returned.

cases.name: json-serialisation
cases.why: The flattened JWS JSON serialisation of a valid snapshot is refused, since only the compact form is accepted.

outcome.message: That is not an entitlements snapshot. Pass the token snapshot() returned.

cases.name: blank-token

outcome.message: That is not an entitlements snapshot. Pass the token snapshot() returned.

cases.name: whitespace-token

outcome.message: That is not an entitlements snapshot. Pass the token snapshot() returned.

cases.name: header-not-json
cases.why: A header segment that is valid base64url but not JSON is refused.

outcome.message: That is not an entitlements snapshot. Pass the token snapshot() returned.

cases.name: header-an-array

outcome.message: That is not an entitlements snapshot. Pass the token snapshot() returned.

cases.name: header-null
cases.why: A header that is JSON null, not an object, is refused.

outcome.message: That is not an entitlements snapshot. Pass the token snapshot() returned.

cases.name: header-not-base64url
cases.why: A header segment with a character outside the base64url alphabet is refused, although a lenient decoder that skips it would read a valid header and the signature covers the segment as sent.

outcome.message: That is not an entitlements snapshot. Pass the token snapshot() returned.

cases.name: signature-not-base64url
cases.why: A signature segment with a character outside the base64url alphabet is refused, although a lenient decoder that skips it would read a valid signature.

outcome.message: That is not an entitlements snapshot. Pass the token snapshot() returned.

cases.name: payload-not-base64url
cases.why: A payload segment with a character outside the base64url alphabet fails step 1, although the signature covers the segment as sent.

outcome.message: That is not an entitlements snapshot. Pass the token snapshot() returned.

cases.name: header-with-padding
cases.why: A header segment with = padding fails step 1, since segments are unpadded base64url, although the signature covers the padded segment.

outcome.message: That is not an entitlements snapshot. Pass the token snapshot() returned.

cases.name: payload-with-padding
cases.why: A payload segment with = padding fails step 1, although the signature covers the padded segment.

outcome.message: That is not an entitlements snapshot. Pass the token snapshot() returned.

cases.name: signature-with-padding
cases.why: A valid signature segment with = padding fails step 1, since segments are unpadded base64url.

outcome.message: That is not an entitlements snapshot. Pass the token snapshot() returned.

cases.name: typ-jwt
cases.why: The header's typ must be entitlements+jwt, so a plain JWT is refused even with a valid signature.

outcome.message: That is not an entitlements snapshot. Pass the token snapshot() returned.

cases.name: typ-customer-token
cases.why: A token typed as a customer token is not a snapshot, even when a snapshot key signed it.

outcome.message: That is not an entitlements snapshot. Pass the token snapshot() returned.

cases.name: typ-missing
cases.why: A header without typ is refused.

outcome.message: That is not an entitlements snapshot. Pass the token snapshot() returned.

cases.name: typ-in-capitals
cases.why: The header's typ must be exactly entitlements+jwt, so Entitlements+JWT is refused, although media types compare without case elsewhere.

outcome.message: That is not an entitlements snapshot. Pass the token snapshot() returned.

cases.name: typ-with-application-prefix
cases.why: The header's typ must be exactly entitlements+jwt, so the full media type application/entitlements+jwt is refused.

outcome.message: That is not an entitlements snapshot. Pass the token snapshot() returned.

cases.name: alg-es384
cases.why: The header's alg must be ES256, so ES384 is refused.

outcome.message: That is not an entitlements snapshot. Pass the token snapshot() returned.

cases.name: alg-hs256-with-public-key-as-secret
cases.why: The algorithm confusion attack, an HMAC keyed with the public key, is refused on alg before any signature check.

outcome.message: That is not an entitlements snapshot. Pass the token snapshot() returned.

cases.name: alg-none
cases.why: An unsecured token with alg none and an empty signature segment is refused.

outcome.message: That is not an entitlements snapshot. Pass the token snapshot() returned.

cases.name: crit-with-valid-signature
cases.why: A header with a crit member is refused even though the signature is valid, since Entitler sets none.

outcome.message: That is not an entitlements snapshot. Pass the token snapshot() returned.

cases.name: crit-empty-array
cases.why: An empty crit array is still a crit member.

outcome.message: That is not an entitlements snapshot. Pass the token snapshot() returned.

cases.name: crit-null
cases.why: A crit member that is null is still a crit member, so the header is refused.

outcome.message: That is not an entitlements snapshot. Pass the token snapshot() returned.

cases.name: unknown-kid
cases.why: A header kid that none of the keys passed has fails the key lookup at step 2.

outcome.message: None of the keys passed signed this snapshot. Fetch them again with snapshotKeys().

cases.name: kid-differs-in-case
cases.why: The kid is compared exactly, so a kid that differs only in case names no key.

outcome.message: None of the keys passed signed this snapshot. Fetch them again with snapshotKeys().

cases.name: kid-missing
cases.why: A header without kid names no key, so step 2 refuses it.

outcome.message: None of the keys passed signed this snapshot. Fetch them again with snapshotKeys().

cases.name: kid-null
cases.why: A header kid that is null is not a string, so step 2 refuses it.

outcome.message: None of the keys passed signed this snapshot. Fetch them again with snapshotKeys().

cases.name: kid-a-number
cases.why: A header kid that is a number is not a string, so step 2 refuses it.

outcome.message: None of the keys passed signed this snapshot. Fetch them again with snapshotKeys().

cases.name: kid-an-array-holding-the-kid
cases.why: A header kid that is an array holding the key's kid is not a string, so step 2 refuses it, which catches loose comparisons.

outcome.message: None of the keys passed signed this snapshot. Fetch them again with snapshotKeys().

cases.name: empty-key-set
cases.why: A key set with no keys has no key for any kid.

outcome.message: None of the keys passed signed this snapshot. Fetch them again with snapshotKeys().

cases.name: signed-by-a-key-not-passed
cases.why: A snapshot signed by a key the app has not fetched yet fails at the key lookup, as section 9 describes for key rotation.

outcome.message: None of the keys passed signed this snapshot. Fetch them again with snapshotKeys().

cases.name: signature-bit-flipped
cases.why: One flipped bit in s makes the signature invalid.

outcome.message: This snapshot was changed after Entitler signed it.

cases.name: payload-changed-after-signing
cases.why: The payload was replaced after signing to extend exp by a year, keeping the original signature.

outcome.message: This snapshot was changed after Entitler signed it.

cases.name: signed-by-the-other-key-under-this-kid
cases.why: The header's kid names the first key, but the second key signed the token.

outcome.message: This snapshot was changed after Entitler signed it.

cases.name: signature-in-der
cases.why: A DER-encoded ECDSA signature is refused, since JWS ES256 takes the 64-byte raw r||s; a verifier that also accepts DER is caught.

outcome.message: This snapshot was changed after Entitler signed it.

cases.name: signature-all-zero
cases.why: An r and s of zero are out of range, and the failure surfaces as the step 3 error rather than the library's own exception.

outcome.message: This snapshot was changed after Entitler signed it.

cases.name: signature-63-bytes
cases.why: A signature one byte short of 64 is invalid.

outcome.message: This snapshot was changed after Entitler signed it.

cases.name: signature-65-bytes
cases.why: A valid signature with one extra byte is not 64 bytes, so step 3 refuses it, although its first 64 bytes verify.

outcome.message: This snapshot was changed after Entitler signed it.

cases.name: signature-empty
cases.why: An empty signature segment under alg ES256 is not 64 bytes, so step 3 refuses it.

outcome.message: This snapshot was changed after Entitler signed it.

cases.name: key-not-on-curve
cases.why: The key with the token's kid has x and y that are not a point on P-256, so it cannot be imported, which is the step 3 error.

outcome.message: This snapshot was changed after Entitler signed it.

cases.name: claims-not-json

outcome.message: That is not an entitlements snapshot. Pass the token snapshot() returned.

cases.name: claims-an-array

outcome.message: That is not an entitlements snapshot. Pass the token snapshot() returned.

cases.name: claims-track-name-missing

cases.name: claims-testers-a-string

cases.name: claims-entitlements-an-object

outcome.message: That is not an entitlements snapshot. Pass the token snapshot() returned.

cases.name: claims-entitlement-not-an-object
cases.why: An entitlement item that is a string, not an object, is malformed, so step 4 refuses the snapshot.

cases.name: claims-entitlement-key-missing

outcome.message: That is not an entitlements snapshot. Pass the token snapshot() returned.

cases.name: claims-entitlement-value-a-string
cases.why: An entitlement value must be true, a whole number or unlimited, so yes is malformed and step 4 refuses the snapshot.

cases.name: claims-entitlement-remaining-on

cases.name: claims-iat-missing
cases.why: The iat claim must be an integer, so a token without one is refused.

cases.name: claims-iat-a-string
